name: MentoTex Advanced Shop Search for WooCommerce
author: H. Bakhtiari

sections.description:
MentoTex Advanced Shop Search adds a powerful query panel inside the WooCommerce admin that lets shop managers combine filters across five categories — Orders, Customers, Products, Financial, and Time — without writing a single line of code.

The problem it solves

The default order screen only offers a basic search bar. Finding customers who bought a specific product in a date range, spent above a threshold, and live in a certain country normally requires a developer or a paid external tool. MentoTex Advanced Shop Search makes this available to any shop manager, for free, right inside wp-admin.

Key features

  • Filter by product, category, SKU, coupon, and product tag
  • Filter by customer country, city, state, registration date, churn risk, one-time buyer, and lifetime value
  • Filter by order status, payment method, shipping method, date range, items per order, and refund status
  • Filter by financial data: order total, discount, shipping cost, tax, and free shipping
  • Filter by time: day of week, last order date, and activity window
  • Combine filters across multiple tabs for complex customer segmentation
  • Results table with customer name linked directly to the user profile
  • Popup showing every order ID per customer, each linked to its order edit screen
  • One-click CSV export of the full result set, including all order IDs

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, transmit, or share any data. It reads from your local WooCommerce database only. No external services are contacted. No tracking or analytics of any kind.

Developed and maintained by MentoTex

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Advanced Search to start building queries.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create new database tables?

No. The plugin only reads from existing WooCommerce tables. It creates no new tables and leaves no data behind when uninstalled.

Does it work with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS)?

Yes. The plugin is fully HPOS-compatible and declares this compatibility to WooCommerce on load. It queries the wc_orders, wc_order_stats, wc_customer_lookup, and related HPOS tables directly.

What is the maximum number of results?

The current version returns up to 500 customers per query, ordered by total spent descending.

Can I export the results?

Yes. After running a search, an Export CSV button appears above the results table. The CSV includes customer name, email, city, country, order count, total spent, first and last order dates, all order IDs, and a profile link.

Does the plugin contact any external servers?

No. All filtering and querying happens locally against your WooCommerce database. No tracking, no telemetry, no external API calls.
